title: lootframe
summary: MSUI's loot window is a close counterpart of current Benilla's: the 256x256 UI-LootPanel at the left UIPanel seat, quality-colored rows, synthesized coin row, 4-row/3+pager law, minimize close, shared item tooltip, click/autoloot wire, and client-authoritative auto-release are present. LootFrameUiLaw now also freezes the exact Lua-owned OnShow fork: empty loot plays LOOTWINDOWOPENEMPTY with the corpse overlay; non-empty fishing loot plays FISHING REEL IN and swaps to FishingLoot-Icon; ordinary non-empty loot remains silent because its sound is C-side and current Benilla intentionally does not guess a kit.

openItems.text: No loot-window sounds (reference LootFrame_OnShow plays per-loot-type open kits, e.g. LOOTWINDOWOPENEMPTY); Program.Loot.cs has no PlaySound calls
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: exact current LootFrame_OnShow empty/fishing sound precedence is implemented through LootFrameUiLaw; ordinary loot intentionally stays silent exactly as current Benilla's Lua adapter does.

openItems.text: Skull overlay is static corpse art only - fishing loot icon swap not modeled (same reduction Benilla notes for itself)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: non-empty loot type 3 now selects Interface\LootFrame\FishingLoot-Icon; every other branch resets to TargetDead.
